items.t: Advocated legislation on voting rights restoration and redistricting.
items.q: Throughout her career, Lucas has advocated legislation related to voting rights restoration, reducing firearms purchases and expanding background checks, redistricting, regulation of casino gaming, and expansion of health care for Virginians.

items.t: Opened The Cannabis Outlet, a cannabis store, in Portsmouth, Virginia, with her daughter (2021).
items.q: In 2021, Lucas and her daughter, Lisa Lucas-Burke, opened The Cannabis Outlet in Portsmouth, Virginia.

record.t: Became the first woman and the first African American elected president pro tempore of the Senate of Virginia in December 2019.
record.q: in December 2019 she became the first woman and the first African American elected its president pro tempore

record.t: Was elected to represent Virginia's 18th District in the Senate of Virginia.
record.q: In 1991 Lucas was elected to represent southeastern Virginia's 18th District in the Senate of Virginia, and in December 2019 she became the first woman and the first African American elected its president pro tempore.

record.t: Became the first Black woman to win election to the Portsmouth City Council (1984).
record.q: she embarked on a political career in 1984 when she became the first Black woman to win election to the Portsmouth City Council

record.t: Chairs the Senate Finance and Appropriations Committee.
record.q: Lucas, who also chairs the powerful Senate Finance and Appropriations Committee, was indicted alongside six others in what federal prosecutors allege was a yearslong criminal enterprise
